scope: Minimum final production wiring successor; no image publication, Terraform apply, Slot 01 release, company access, or real-company M1-M5 execution.

root_cause_closure.legacy_production_entry_point: The M6.7 sampled-slot production task now invokes only opintel_intelligence_worker.sampled_slot_execution_main. Identity-bearing caller arguments are rejected. Legacy pollers exclude reserved sampled-slot records and cannot consume real M6.7 sampled-slot work.
root_cause_closure.durable_predecessor_lineage: The coordinator persists immutable run, work-item, slot, stage, predecessor artifact ID, predecessor revision, predecessor hash, accepted state, and transition identity. Downstream stages use exact IDs and revisions rather than latest-record selection.
root_cause_closure.bounded_release_applicator: The release applicator accepts only an immutable owner-approval artifact, validates its hash and every frozen package, slot, business, host, A-09, runtime, component, window, ceiling, permission, kill-switch, and supersession binding, then creates one exact release idempotently.
root_cause_closure.single_use_chain: One production entry point applies the exact release, derives one frozen-registry work item, runs the bounded coordinator through M1-M5, reaches CONTACT_PHASE_NOT_AUTHORIZED, consumes the release, returns REAL_PUBLIC_RESEARCH to NOT_AUTHORIZED, and trips the kill switch.

validation.positive_chain: Exact synthetic owner approval -> exact release -> frozen-registry work item -> accepted synthetic M1 -> M2 -> M3 -> M4 -> M5 -> CONTACT_PHASE_NOT_AUTHORIZED -> authority consumed.
negative_matrix: malformed or unapproved artifact creates no release
wrong slot, package, business, hostname, A-09, runtime, component hash, window, ceiling, or permission creates no release
duplicate release application creates no duplicate run
legacy pollers cannot claim real sampled-slot work
M2 without exact accepted M1 is blocked
M3 without exact accepted M2 is blocked
M4 or M5 stage skipping is blocked
coordinator restart resumes the same immutable chain
kill switch or absent, expired, revoked, malformed authority blocks before DNS or transport

known_local_runner_limit: A rootless Buildah container-run import check could not mount its local runtime directory. Repository imports, compilation, deterministic tests, archive inspection, SBOM generation, and offline scans passed; no network fallback or artifact substitution was used.
